SP-081.1: a1: at 0fb9e33 each of orchd's 91 RPCs registers its caller class and space decision with one registerRPCs(taskRPC|operatorRPC) line above its handler, in the handler's file; taskCallable, operatorActions and readSpaceDecisions are declared empty. TestEachRPCRegistersBesideItsHandler (internal/daemon/rpc_registry_test.go) parses the package and fails for an RPC registered twice, away from its handler's file, or listed in one of the three map literals (checked by mutation: a moved, a deleted and a re-listed entry each fail it). TestRegistrationFillsEveryTable, TestRegistrationRefusesConflicts and TestRegisterRPCsFillsOrchdsMaps cover registerRPCs, which panics on a second claim, an operator RPC without an action or a missing method.
